title: news_feeds.search
description: Keyword search over the node's curated article pool (title / summary / feed name) backed by SQLite FTS5 with porter stemming. Returns articles ordered by FTS5 rank, then published_at desc as tiebreaker. Search scope is the polled feed pool only — off-feed topics return an empty list rather than reaching out to the open web. Optionally filters by category and / or urgency bucket; both AND-combine with the FTS5 match.

query.description: Free-text keyword query. The handler tokenises into individual words and combines them with FTS5 AND semantics; porter stemming matches plurals and common verb forms ('wildfire' matches 'wildfires', 'report' matches 'reporting'). Special FTS5 punctuation is stripped — pass plain words.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Default 20 if omitted; clamped to 50.

category.description: Optional category filter. A single category string, or an array of 1–7 unique category strings. Articles whose category is in the resulting set are returned. Omit to search across all categories.

urgency.description: Optional urgency filter. A single urgency bucket, or an array of 1–3 unique buckets. Articles whose urgency is in the resulting set are returned. Same heuristic buckets as news_feeds.recent. AND-combines with the FTS5 match and the optional category filter.
